in_marathi.name: Chetvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Four directions, compass
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chetvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chetvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chetas' meaning 'consciousness' and 'Vikas' meaning 'growth'. It represents the four directions and symbolizes the growth of consciousness towards enlightenment.
